create_config_flava_image: create a FlavaImageConfig with custom hidden_size, patch_size, and image_size for image encoder initialization
create_config_flava_text: create a FlavaTextConfig with custom vocab_size, max_position_embeddings, and hidden_size for text encoder initialization
create_config_flava_multimodal: create a FlavaMultimodalConfig with custom num_hidden_layers and use_cls_token for multimodal encoder initialization
create_config_flava_image_codebook: create a FlavaImageCodebookConfig with custom num_groups, hidden_size, and vocab_size for image codebook initialization
create_config_flava: create a FlavaConfig that composes text, image, multimodal, and image_codebook sub-configs with loss weights
